summary: Voters in Festus removed members of the city council who had supported data center development.

source.citation: KCUR, September 17 2026, quoting a Festus resident at a Missouri Capitol rally

notes: Recorded as a distinct mechanism. Every other entry in this corpus records an instrument adopted by a governing body or a court. This records the replacement of the governing body itself. No jurisdiction tracker identified in this corpus treats electoral turnover as a data center outcome.
confidence_note: No election record has been read. Which offices, which election, the margins, and whether data centers were the operative issue are all NOT_CHECKED. The account is a resident's statement reported at a rally, and is a single-hop relay of a partisan speaker.
